exercises.title: Bus 1 — Address, data and control lines
exercises.problemHtml:
Concept questions about system buses and arbitration.

This set has 5 questions. There is nothing to run: answer in the panel on the right and press Submit. The questions follow the style of the CEA201 final exam, so work them out on paper first, exactly as you would in the exam hall.

Requirements

  • Answer every question in the answer panel, then press Submit.
  • All answers must be correct to get Accepted; the explanations appear after you submit.
exercises.problemHtmlVi:

Bộ này có 5 câu. Không có gì để chạy: trả lời trong khung bên phải rồi bấm Nộp. Câu hỏi theo phong cách đề FE của môn CEA201, nên hãy giải ra giấy trước như khi ngồi phòng thi.

solutionCodeJson.code:
# Bus 1 — Address, data and control lines — answer key

1. The width of the ADDRESS bus determines …Độ rộng bus ĐỊA CHỈ quyết định …
   Answer: a) the maximum memory capacity that can be addressed
   n address lines can name 2ⁿ locations.VI: n đường địa chỉ gọi tên được 2ⁿ vị trí.

2. The width of the DATA bus determines …Độ rộng bus DỮ LIỆU quyết định …
   Answer: b) how many bits can be transferred at one time
   A wider data bus moves more bits per bus cycle, raising bandwidth.VI: Bus dữ liệu rộng hơn chuyển nhiều bit hơn mỗi chu kỳ bus, tăng băng thông.

3. Why do systems use bus ARBITRATION?Vì sao hệ thống dùng PHÂN XỬ bus?
   Answer: c) Only one master may drive the bus at a time
   When several masters want the bus, arbitration (centralized or distributed) chooses one.VI: Khi nhiều master cùng muốn bus, phân xử (tập trung hoặc phân tán) chọn một.

4. In an ASYNCHRONOUS bus, transfers are timed by …Ở bus BẤT ĐỒNG BỘ, việc truyền được định thời bởi …
   Answer: d) a handshake between master and slave
   Request/acknowledge signals replace the common clock.VI: Tín hiệu yêu cầu/xác nhận thay cho xung nhịp chung.

5. Compared to a shared bus, a point-to-point interconnect (PCIe, QPI) …So với bus dùng chung, kết nối điểm-điểm (PCIe, QPI) …
   Answer: a) avoids bus contention and clocking problems and scales to higher speeds
   Dedicated serial links remove the shared-bus bottleneck.VI: Liên kết nối tiếp riêng loại bỏ nút cổ chai của bus dùng chung.

exercises.title: Bus 2 — Bus bandwidth and address space
exercises.problemHtml:
Peak bandwidth (MB/s, 10⁶ bytes) = width/8 × clock × transfers per cycle (1 for single data rate, 2 for double). Fill in the bandwidth, and for a bus with A address lines, the number of addressable bytes (give powers of two as 2^A).

This set has 2 tables. There is nothing to run: answer in the panel on the right and press Submit. The questions follow the style of the CEA201 final exam, so work them out on paper first, exactly as you would in the exam hall.

Requirements

  • Answer every question in the answer panel, then press Submit.
  • All answers must be correct to get Accepted; the explanations appear after you submit.
exercises.problemHtmlVi:
Băng thông đỉnh (MB/s, 10⁶ byte) = độ rộng/8 × clock × số lần truyền mỗi chu kỳ (1 với SDR, 2 với DDR). Điền băng thông và với bus có A đường địa chỉ, số byte địa chỉ hoá được (viết luỹ thừa 2 dạng 2^A).

Bộ này có 2 bảng. Không có gì để chạy: trả lời trong khung bên phải rồi bấm Nộp. Câu hỏi theo phong cách đề FE của môn CEA201, nên hãy giải ra giấy trước như khi ngồi phòng thi.

exercises.title: Bus 3 — Order an asynchronous read handshake
exercises.problemHtml:
On an asynchronous bus the master and slave coordinate with two control lines: MSYN (master ready) and SSYN (slave ready). Put the read cycle in order.

This set has 1 question. There is nothing to run: answer in the panel on the right and press Submit. The questions follow the style of the CEA201 final exam, so work them out on paper first, exactly as you would in the exam hall.

solutionCodeJson.code:
# Bus 3 — Order an asynchronous read handshake — answer key

1. Asynchronous read cycleChu kỳ đọc bất đồng bộ
   Answer: s1) The master puts the address and the READ command on the bus  →  s2) The master asserts MSYN  →  s3) The slave decodes the address, puts the data on the bus and asserts SSYN  →  s4) The master reads the data and negates MSYN  →  s5) The slave sees MSYN negated, removes the data and negates SSYN
   A full handshake: each signal change is a reply to the previous one, so no clock is needed.VI: Bắt tay đầy đủ: mỗi thay đổi tín hiệu là câu trả lời cho thay đổi trước, nên không cần clock.

exercises.solutionExplanationHtml:
A full handshake: each signal change is a reply to the previous one, so no clock is needed.

VI: Bắt tay đầy đủ: mỗi thay đổi tín hiệu là câu trả lời cho thay đổi trước, nên không cần clock.

The master reads the data and negates MSYN

exercises.title: Bus 4 — Sizing the buses of a small system
exercises.problemHtml:
A byte-addressable memory of the given size sits on a bus with the given data width. How many address lines are needed, and how many bus transfers does it take to move one cache line of the given size?

This set has 1 table. There is nothing to run: answer in the panel on the right and press Submit. The questions follow the style of the CEA201 final exam, so work them out on paper first, exactly as you would in the exam hall.

Requirements

  • Answer every question in the answer panel, then press Submit.
  • All answers must be correct to get Accepted; the explanations appear after you submit.
exercises.problemHtmlVi:
